players.bio: Adrian Leon Barišić (Croatian pronunciation: ; born 19 July 2001) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Swiss Super League club Basel and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team. Barišić started his professional career at Osijek, who loaned him to Frosinone in 2022. The following year, he moved to Basel.

Alaa Bellaarouch (born 1 January 2002) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Primeira Liga club Braga. Club career Bellaarouch was trained at the Mohammed VI Football Academy in Salé. In 2020, he left Morocco to sign for French club Strasbourg, initially joining the reserve team. In 2022, he signed for Stade Briochin on loan until the end of the season.
Alef Dos Santos Saldanha (né le 28 janvier 1995 à Nova Odessa (São Paulo)) est un footballeur brésilien qui évolue au poste de milieu défensif à l'Olympique de Marseille.

Bright Akwo Arrey-Mbi (born 26 March 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Primeira Liga club Braga. Born in Cameroon, he has represented England and Germany at youth levels internationally.

Carlos Augusto Soares da Costa Faria Carvalhal (born 4 December 1965) is a Portuguese former footballer who played as a centre-back, currently manager of Primeira Liga club Braga. As a player, he totalled 197 Primeira Liga appearances in service of six clubs, including two spells each at Braga and Chaves, as well as a single game for Porto.

Denis Huseinbašić (pronounced ; born 3 July 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for 2. Bundesliga club 1. FC Köln. Born in Germany, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team. Huseinbašić started his professional career at Kickers Offenbach, before joining 1. FC Köln in 2022.

Eduardo dos Reis Carvalho ComM (born 19 September 1982), known simply as Eduardo, is a Portuguese former footballer who played as a goalkeeper. He appeared in 138 Primeira Liga games over 11 seasons, almost always representing Braga. He also played professionally in Italy, Turkey, Croatia, England and the Netherlands.
Demir Ege Tıknaz (born 17 August 2004) is a Turkish footballer who plays as a midfielder for Beşiktaş.

Francisco José "Fran" Navarro Aliaga (born 3 February 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Super League Greece club Olympiacos, on loan from Porto. Club career Valencia Born in Valencia, Navarro moved as a youth across the city from Levante UD to Valencia CF, where he played mostly with the reserve team in Segunda División B.
Gabriel "Gabri" Martínez Aguilera (born 22 January 2003) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a forward for Portuguese club SC Braga.

Gustaf Johan Lagerbielke, 11th Baron Lagerbielke is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Primeira Liga side Braga and the Sweden national team. Gustaf Lagerbielke grew up in Djursholm outside Stockholm. His mother is Katarina Waldenström, an entrepreneur, and his father is Count Johan Lagerbjelke, a public speaker and negotiation expert.

João Filipe Iria Santos Moutinho ComM (born 8 September 1986) is a Portuguese footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Primeira Liga club Braga. Moutinho began his professional career with Sporting CP, moving in 2010 to FC Porto and winning twelve major titles between the two clubs combined.

Jonas Older Wind (born 7 February 1999) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club VfL Wolfsburg. He is the son of former goalkeeper Per Wind, though the younger Wind plays as a forward.

Jovan Milošević (Serbian Cyrillic: Јован Милошевић; born 31 July 2005) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen, on loan from VfB Stuttgart, and the Serbia national team. Club career On 10 July 2022, Milošević made his first-team debut for Vojvodina, replacing Nebojša Bastajić in the 65th minute in a 1–0 home win against Napredak Kruševac.

Marcelo Augusto Ferreira Teixeira (born 13 October 1987) is a Brazilian professional footballer playing for Braga in Primeira Liga as a defender. Club career Born in Goias, Goiano played for various clubs in the lower leagues. He spent the 2012–2013 at Feirense on loan from Grêmio Anápolis.

Maho Yepie Dorgeles Guy-Mario Bocha (born 7 August 2004) is an Ivorian footballer who plays as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club Braga and the Ivory Coast national team. Dorgeles was included in the Ivory Coast U23 squad for friendlies in November 2023. Dorgeles made his debut for the national team on 21 November 2023 against Iraq under-23 national team.
Mauro Zalazar Martínez is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder. Born in Spain, he represents Uruguay at youth level.

Pau Víctor Delgado (born 26 November 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga club Barcelona. Mainly a striker, he can also play as a right winger, a left winger and an attacking midfielder.
Ricardo Jorge Luz Horta (born 15 September 1994) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for S.C. Braga and the Portugal national team as a right winger.
Sergio Barcia Laranxeira (born 31 December 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Ekstraklasa club Legia Warsaw.

Sikou Niakaté (born 10 July 1999) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Metz on loan from Guingamp. Club career Niakaté made his professional debut for Valenciennes FC in a 1–0 Ligue 2 loss to Nîmes Olympique on 31 July 2017, making his appearance at the age of 18.
Víctor Gómez Perea (born 1 April 2000) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a right back for CD Mirandés, on loan from RCD Espanyol.
Vitor Carvalho Vieira (born 27 May 1997), known as Vitor Carvalho, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club Braga.
Victor Hugo Mateus Golas (born 27 December 1990 in Arapongas, Paraná) is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Portuguese club S.C. Braga as a goalkeeper.
